P076.title: Long-term freeze–thaw cycle behavior of high-speed railway embankment in frozen soil regions and its effects on train-track dynamic interaction system
P076.authors: Z Li, W Wang, L Xu, B Peng
P076.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: The temperature field of permafrost is accompanied by freeze-thaw cycles of moisture during the long-term evolution, thus, the phase transformation of moisture in the soil must be considered.

The moisture of embankment and subsoil in the frozen soil region can be divided into three zones: frozen zone with the solid phase, unfrozen zone with the liquid phase, and active phase transformation zone with the solid-liquid phase, as shown in Fig. 3.
